Data quality shows 24.992 real / 0 synthetic. Data providers shows Iberinform as Operativo with 24,992 records. Oportunidades screen loads both views (Por impacto / Más recientes) with filters and displays the GESTORA JR SANCHEZ succession opportunity.

This appears to be a stale UI label since the underlying companies are now 100% real. It does not affect this task's acceptance criteria (empresas_reales=24992 / sintéticas=0 are shown correctly) but should be revisited so the coverage rows don't confusingly say 'sintético' for what is now real coverage.
